summary: Dossiers were mostly accurate on the established DC history (go-go, Bullets rename, Goodman, Ben's, statehood, Emancipation Day). Fixes: the cherry-blossom City Edition is a bright-pink base, not pink on navy (live-confirmed, and confirmed returning); the old arena name was updated to CareFirst Arena; Oct 30 was demoted from 'home opener' to a confirmed Cup Night; Spingarn, Songbyrd, Oohh's & Aahh's, Clyde's and a few dubious credits were removed or softened; and Gilbert Arenas's 2025 federal gambling charge was added as a caveat. The strategy brief needs the editor's attention: its Oct 30 and mid-October launch timeline is unrealistic from Oct 7, and its Aug 22 seeding date has passed.
